message.content: It sounds like you’re describing Boston’s summer heat! While Boston can get warm, the typical high temperatures in July and August usually range from about 25 °C to 30 °C (77 °F to 86 °F). A 54 °C (≈129 °F) peak would be far beyond what the city normally experiences—such temperatures are more common in places like Phoenix or Riyadh. If you’re planning a trip or just curious about local climate, the average highs in Boston’s hottest months are comfortably in the mid‑20s Celsius.
